items.description: Implement code-aware indexing in MemoryStore using AST to extract functions, classes, and docstrings.
Add stopword filtering and keyword weighting to hrr.encode_text to improve holographic SNR.
Implement associative entity probing in FactRetriever to follow chains of thought during context retrieval.
Integrate active contradiction resolution into run_hygiene to prune stale or conflicting facts.
Implement SNR-driven forgetting to prune low-trust facts when memory bank capacity is reached.
Create a Memory Analysis sub-agent to periodically summarize past failures and update the Knowledge Base.
